name: Creosote Pom-Pom Gall Midge
desc: Creosote Pom-Pom Gall Midge (Asphondylia auripila): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asphondylia auripila, the large creosote gall midge, is a species of gall midge in the family Cecidomyiidae. This species utilizes creosote bushes as host plants for forming galls.
